component.name: ktamine
component.summary: Keep your computer awake from the system tray

description.p: A small tray app for KDE Plasma, inspired by Amphetamine on macOS. Click the coffee cup to stop your computer from sleeping, and click again to let it sleep.

ul.li: Keep awake indefinitely, for a set time, or until a clock time
Keep awake while an app is running or while files are downloading
Optionally let the display sleep while the computer stays awake
A reminder before a timer ends, with buttons to extend it
End the session when you suspend the computer or lock the screen
A global shortcut and command-line options

screenshot.caption: The tray menu and its settings

description.p: Fixes download detection in nested folders and lists apps started at login.
